name: element.wait
description: Polling form of element.find: re-runs the search every 250 ms until a match appears (and optionally meets `flags_required`) or the timeout expires. Capability-gated — check `system.capabilities` before calling.

root.description: Optional window handle to scope the search. If omitted, searches the desktop root.

name.description: Accessible name to match (UIA Name / AX kAXTitle). Case-insensitive substring.

automation_id.description: Stable automation identifier. Preferred over `name` when available — survives localization.

flags_required.description: Wait until the matched element's `flags` include EVERY entry here. Lets callers wait for state transitions (becomes-enabled, becomes-focused) on the matching element. Per issue #92.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Returns ERR not_found if no match (with required flags) appears within this window — same code as element.find for consistency.

name.description: UIA Name property of the matched element.

automation_id.description: UIA AutomationId. Empty string when the element doesn't expose one.

flags.description: Universally-determinable UIA boolean states currently true on the element. Per issue #92.

x-implementations.name: uia_poll
x-implementations.description: Wraps `element.find` in a 250 ms-interval poll loop with deadline. Each iteration walks the visible-element subtree from the root, applies the role/name/automation_id condition, and (if flags_required is set) checks the matched element's flags.

windows-modern.description: Polling FindFirst loop. The 250 ms interval balances responsiveness against UIA query cost (a full subtree walk on a complex window can take 50-100 ms). With `flags_required`, the loop also queries the matched element's UIA boolean properties each iteration. UIPI: the initial search may succeed but the wait blocks under the same uia_blind constraints — the polled subtree may become visible mid-wait if the agent's IL changes (rare).
